reason: NONE. First thing I noticed was the QR code and "Every batch lab-tested" on the front, which is nice, but there are zero reviews and I don't buy without hundreds. I already have a magnesium that works for me, and $29.99 for 30 days is a lot to risk on an unknown brand.
objection: No reviews at all, so I can't check the 1-star complaints about stomach upset, pill size or fake dosing. A QR code is the brand's own claim until real people confirm it.
would_change_my_mind: Several hundred reviews at 4.3 stars or higher, with 1-star reviews that show no stomach problems or dosing complaints.
